paragraphs.text: The Maker is a god on the plane of Cridhe , a plane which he made, hence his name.

The Maker is the creator of Cridhe and is highly venerated there. It is unknown if the Maker is a historical entity or simply a mythological deity. When the Clan Tree of Cridhe , said to be as old as the plane itself, was young, the Maker carved a message in ornate letters onto a stone at its base. Facing the clan is the Blessing, which reads "Keep me, and I will keep you." On the other side of the stone, facing the Tree, is the Curse, which reads "He who harms me harms all the world. My wound shall be his wound, and the darkness of his wound shall not be taken from him, and shall mark his line unto its last generation." The Curse fell on the line of Nohr when he split the stone during the Parting .
When the world was still young, the Maker placed the Gwylfan at Loch Prith . They wove prophecies and teachings of the Maker to shape the plane.
